public interface IBindingDefinitionModelAssembly extends IBindingDefinitionModel, dev.metaschema.core.model.IAssemblyDefinition
Represents a Metaschema assembly definition loaded via data binding.

This interface provides access to assembly-specific metadata including the root name for assemblies that can serve as document roots.
